topics.prompt: Let's build a zero-copy I/O subsystem in the kernel that leverages io_uring to stream data directly from NVMe SSDs to user space without intermediate copies.

topics.name: Implementing a Kernel-Level GraphQL API for Real-Time System Telemetry
topics.prompt: Let's create a kernel module that exposes system telemetry via a GraphQL API, enabling dynamic querying of performance metrics in real time.

topics.name: Formal Verification of a Custom Kernel Scheduler Using Coq and the CompCert Compiler
topics.prompt: Let's formalize a new preemptive scheduler in Coq, compile it with CompCert, and prove its correctness properties within the kernel.

topics.name: Constructing a Secure, Encrypted Filesystem Layer with Kernel-Level FUSE Integration and SGX Attestation
topics.prompt: Let's design a kernel-level encrypted filesystem that uses FUSE for user space interaction and Intel SGX for attesting the integrity of the encryption keys.

topics.name: Adaptive Demand Paging with Machine Learning Predictive Replacement
topics.prompt: Let's design a demand paging system that uses a lightweight ML model to predict future page accesses and minimize page faults.

topics.name: Mixed-Criticality Scheduling with Rate-Monotonic and Earliest Deadline First Hybrid
topics.prompt: Let's formulate a scheduler that dynamically switches between RM and EDF for mixed-criticality tasks in a real-time kernel.

topics.name: Hardware-Accelerated Secure Memory Encryption Using AES-NI and Tagging
topics.prompt: Let's create a kernel module that encrypts user memory pages on the fly using AES-NI and maintains integrity tags.

topics.name: B-Tree Based VFS Metadata Index for High-Throughput File Systems
topics.prompt: Let's implement a VFS layer that stores inode metadata in a B-Tree to accelerate lookups under high concurrency.

topics.name: Predictive Power Management via Kernel-Level Time Series Forecasting
topics.prompt: Let's build a kernel power manager that predicts CPU load using ARIMA and adjusts frequency scaling accordingly.

topics.name: Zero-Page Memory Mapping with NUMA-Aware Page Allocation
topics.prompt: Let's design and implement a zero-page memory mapping scheme that allocates zero pages from the nearest NUMA node to reduce cross-node traffic in a multi-socket system.

topics.name: Hybrid Kernel Scheduler with Real-Time Guarantees Using Hierarchical Rate Monotonic and EDF
topics.prompt: Let's build a kernel scheduler that combines Hierarchical Rate Monotonic (HRM) for periodic tasks with Earliest Deadline First (EDF) for sporadic tasks, ensuring hard real-time constraints in a mixed-criticality environment.

topics.name: Fault-Tolerant Kernel Module for Hot-Plugging GPUs Using PCIe Resizable BARs
topics.prompt: Let's develop a kernel module that supports hot-plugging of GPUs by dynamically resizing BARs, handling state migration, and ensuring zero-downtime for GPU-accelerated workloads.

topics.name: Kernel-Level Cryptographic Acceleration: Integrating Intel AES-NI into the Linux Crypto API with Asynchronous I/O
topics.prompt: Let's integrate Intel AES-NI instructions into the Linux crypto API, exposing an asynchronous I/O interface for high-throughput encryption/decryption in user space.

topics.name: Kernel-Mode Network Stack with BPF eXpress (XDP) for Ultra-Low Latency Packet Processing
topics.prompt: Let's build a kernel-mode network stack that leverages XDP and eBPF programs to achieve sub-microsecond packet processing, including custom load balancing and congestion control.

topics.name: Hybrid Kernel Memory Management: Transparent Hugepage Scheduler with Custom Page Migration
topics.prompt: Let's design and implement a kernel module that dynamically schedules transparent hugepages across NUMA nodes, using a graph-based migration algorithm that minimizes memory latency.

topics.name: Real-Time Scheduling with SCHED_DEADLINE: Custom Priority Inheritance Mechanism
topics.prompt: Let's implement a custom priority inheritance scheme for SCHED_DEADLINE tasks, modifying the kernel's task_struct to track wait dependencies and adjusting the scheduler's time slice accordingly.

topics.name: KVM Hypervisor for ARM Cortex-A: Lightweight Virtualization Layer
topics.prompt: Let's build a lightweight KVM hypervisor for ARM Cortex-A CPUs, implementing stage-2 translation tables and exception vector handling, and expose a userspace API for VM creation.

topics.name: NVMe over Fabrics Device Driver: Asynchronous I/O with libaio Integration
topics.prompt: Let's develop a kernel NVMe-oF driver that uses libaio for asynchronous I/O, implements RDMA transport over RoCE, and handles command submission queues with zero-copy buffers.

topics.name: Kernel Security Module: Mandatory Access Control for Container Isolation
topics.prompt: Let's design a kernel security module that provides a Mandatory Access Control policy layer for container isolation, integrating with SELinux's policy language and AppArmor profiles, and enforcing namespace constraints.

topics.name: Implementing the Linux Semaphore Wait Queue Algorithm
topics.prompt: Discuss the intricacies of the semaphore wait queue algorithm used in the Linux kernel, and provide an example implementation in C.

topics.name: Designing a High-Performance Scheduling Algorithm for Real-Time Systems
topics.prompt: Design and analyze a scheduling algorithm for real-time systems that minimizes latency and maximizes throughput, using a case study of a real-world system.

topics.name: Optimizing the Linux Page Cache using a Least Recently Used (LRU) Cache Replacement Policy
topics.prompt: Explain the LRU cache replacement policy and its implementation in the Linux page cache, and discuss optimization techniques to improve cache performance.

topics.name: Implementing the Amdahl's Law-based Performance Modeling for Multicore Systems
topics.prompt: Derive and implement Amdahl's Law-based performance models for a multicore system, and analyze the impact of thread-level parallelism on overall system performance.

topics.name: Designing a Priority Scheduling Algorithm for Embedded Systems with Limited Resources
topics.prompt: Design a priority scheduling algorithm for an embedded system with limited resources, taking into account constraints such as memory and power consumption, and analyze its performance using a case study.
